stories.label: Iran crisis — Tehran and Washington diverge on sanctions as deadline passes
stories.summary: Iran and US diverge on sanctions relief scope but have scheduled new talks for early March. Iran offering nuclear reduction steps while refusing to give up enriched uranium or oil exports. Deadline ~Feb 23-24 passing without immediate breakdown or breakthrough — crisis shifting to prolonged negotiation.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — Russia targets energy infrastructure ahead of 4th anniversary
stories.summary: Russia now targeting energy infrastructure in widescale drone and missile attacks ahead of Feb 24 anniversary. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle and energy strikes are a continuation. Watch for anniversary developments.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — nations cut bilateral deals as 15% regime takes hold
stories.summary: Tariffs at 15% via Section 122. Capital flight accelerating. EU-Mercosur tensions partly driven by tariff realignment. Not directly selected but connected to the EU-Mercosur and Somaliland stories.

stories.label: Pakistan strikes inside Afghanistan — Kabul reports dozens killed
stories.summary: Pakistan cross-border operations inside Afghan territory continue. Taliban reporting dozens killed. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle, no major new development beyond continued strikes.

stories.label: Brazil's Lula visits India with largest-ever delegation, challenges Trump on tariffs
stories.summary: Lula visiting India with largest-ever Brazilian delegation. Global South coordination on tariffs emerging. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle.

stories.label: Indonesia confirms bilateral trade deal with Trump amid tariff chaos
stories.summary: Indonesia secures bilateral trade deal with Trump amid 15% global tariff. Template for SE Asian navigation of the trade war.

stories.label: Nature: Agentic AI system diagnoses rare diseases with traceable reasoning
stories.summary: Published in Nature: agentic AI diagnosing rare diseases with explainable reasoning.

stories.label: Nature RCT proves X's algorithm measurably shifts political attitudes
stories.summary: RCT in Nature proves X/Twitter's recommendation algorithm measurably shifts political attitudes.

stories.label: Israeli settlers declare new settlement deep inside Palestinian Hebron
stories.summary: Settlers establishing new settlement inside Hebron. US ambassador's remarks condemned by 14 nations.

stories.label: Memory chip competition — Samsung reclaims DRAM lead amid Chinese challenge
stories.summary: Samsung regained global DRAM market leadership in Q4. CXMT undercutting DDR4 by ~50%.

stories.label: North Korea Workers' Party Congress — Kim outlines new five-year goals
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un outlined new five-year goals at Workers' Party Ninth Congress. S. Korea/US postponed military drills announcement.

stories.label: IS declares new campaign against Syria's post-Assad government
stories.summary: IS declared new campaign against Sharaa's government. Claimed attacks in Raqqa and Deir al-Zor.

stories.label: Sudan war — Museveni hosts RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue
stories.summary: Uganda's Museveni hosting RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue. UN crossed genocide threshold. Not selected — no major new development.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse — Hezbollah declares resistance only option
stories.summary: Israeli strikes continue killing 10+ per day. Hezbollah says resistance is only option. Ceasefire dead. Decayed to fading — heavily covered, no strategic shift.

stories.label: Five European nations pledge drone defense production using Ukrainian expertise
stories.summary: E5 nations pledge to leverage Ukraine's battlefield drone expertise for low-cost air defense production.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea: Troop movements raise renewed conflict fears
stories.summary: Military troop movements near Eritrea-Tigray border. 2022 Pretoria peace agreement may be unraveling.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2. Colored by tariff escalation. Fading until summit approaches.

stories.label: Chinese chipmaker CXMT undercuts global DDR4 prices by half
stories.summary: CXMT offering DDR4 at ~50% below Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron.

stories.label: Australian warship transits Taiwan Strait tracked by Chinese navy
stories.summary: Australian warship sailed through Taiwan Strait with PLA Navy tracking. AUKUS presence strengthening.

stories.label: Gel material helps mini spinal cords heal from injury
stories.summary: Gel helps spinal cord organoids recover from injury. Potential paralysis treatment breakthrough.

stories.label: 70B-parameter LLM runs on single consumer GPU via NVMe bypass
stories.summary: Running Llama 3.1 70B on a single RTX 3090 via NVMe-to-GPU bypass. Democratizes large AI model access.

stories.label: Wall Street exodus — investors shifting billions from US to overseas markets
stories.summary: US investors moving billions into emerging markets, Europe, Japan. Direct consequence of tariff chaos.

stories.label: Germany's CDU/CSU seeks social media ban for under-14s
stories.summary: Germany's ruling CDU/CSU passed motion for social media ban for under-14s.

stories.label: Philippine senator demands SCS pushback from disputed Thitu Island
stories.summary: Philippine senator visited Thitu Island to call for deepening defense partnerships against Chinese encroachment.

stories.label: Wikipedia bans Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures
stories.summary: Wikipedia deprecated Archive.today over DDoS attacks and altered captures.

stories.label: NASA Artemis II delayed past March over SLS rocket issue
stories.summary: Artemis II pushed from March to at least April. Further delays expected.

stories.label: Ancient Australian salt caverns explored as massive energy storage
stories.summary: Queensland salt caverns explored for compressed-air energy storage at grid scale.

stories.label: Somaliland offers US minerals and military base access for recognition
stories.summary: Unrecognized Somaliland dangles mineral rights and Red Sea military base access to court US recognition. Part of the broader scramble for African strategic minerals.

stories.label: Indonesia evacuates miners in Papua after armed separatist attack
stories.summary: Indonesian military evacuating mining workers including 26 Chinese nationals after armed separatist attack. Decades-long West Papua independence movement rarely covered.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal fracturing as Europe brakes and Argentina accelerates
stories.summary: World's largest proposed trade zone fracturing — European farmers reject the deal while Argentina under Milei races to lock it in. Peronism split on the deal in Argentina's congress.

stories.label: Nature: Rising CO2 depletes nitrogen in boreal forests, undermining carbon sink
stories.summary: Counter-intuitive Nature finding: rising CO2 depletes nitrogen in boreal forests, meaning these ecosystems may absorb far less carbon than climate models predict.

stories.label: New complexity theory framework maps quantum computing limits
stories.summary: Computer scientists built a new theoretical framework for understanding what quantum computers can and cannot do. Foundational work shaping the field.

stories.label: Botnet accidentally destroys I2P privacy network
stories.summary: A botnet inadvertently took down I2P, one of the internet's major privacy networks. Exposes fragility of decentralized infrastructure used by journalists, activists, and people in censored countries.
